fee_notes: First Franchise Agreement requires a $40,000 Initial Franchise Fee plus a $12,500 Initial Training Fee (both non-refundable). Second or subsequent Franchise Agreements carry a reduced Initial Franchise Fee of $25,000, with the Initial Training Fee potentially waived. The Initial Franchise Fee and/or Initial Training Fee may be waived for affiliate-executed agreements, conversions from independent repair stores, or purchases of existing affiliate-owned stores. Under an Area Development Agreement, the first store's Initial Franchise Fee is $40,000 and subsequent stores are $25,000 (with a $12,500-per-store Development Fee credited against subsequent fees). Low set to $25,000 (subsequent/reduced fee) and high set to $40,000 (first store standard fee), excluding the Initial Training Fee of $12,500 which is a separate required fee.
raw_excerpt: You must pay a $40,000 lump sum initial franchise fee (" Initial Franchise Fee ") and a $12,500 initial training fee (" Initial Training Fee") when you sign your first Franchise Agreement for a Store with the potential for one or more Mobile Units depending on the market. The Initial Franchise Fee and Initial Training Fee are not refundable under any circumstances. The Franchise Fee for your second or subsequent Franchise Agreements will be $25,000.
